# Author offline REST SDK contracts: Pipeline orchestration checkpoints and health

## Business outcome
An agent discovers and authors any owned Foundry REST SDK operation using only the standalone pal-found-dev knowledge and prepared SDK/runtime artifacts.

## Owned scope
T37 partition R5; 29 canonical operations in frozen SDK 1.101.0 (all v2.orchestration, v2.checkpoints and v2.data_health operations; owns build-state example in J12). Exact IDs derive from the reviewed SA-DES-014 inventory using these service/resource predicates. All stability states are included. No operation exclusion without recorded Project Owner approval. This story exclusively owns these operation explanations/examples and coordinates shared models under DEV-STORY-069 ownership.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each owned operation maps to a complete local SDK/HTTP contract, meaningful adaptable example, required input/output/model definitions, effects, permissions/prerequisites, errors, availability restrictions and bounded recovery where applicable.
- Synchronous/asynchronous and raw/streaming response forms have locally navigable guidance where exposed; all transitive models/errors resolve within standalone pal-found-dev.
- Fulfill BA-DES-015 BD-015-01,08,11 and seven-element topic contract; independent source/semantic review covers every owned operation, not only journey samples.
- Independent QA authors fixture expectations and selects service/API-version discovery cases without author assistance. Public internet is blocked; enrollment/fixture boundary and missing prerequisites are explicit.
- Preserve 351 CLI operations, other topic owners and valid knowledge. No installation/copy instructions, required sibling skills or internal development-document references in distributed content.
- Essential CLI defects remain FEATURE-012-owned with a linked acceptance blocker. All owned content gaps must be resolved before acceptance.

## Related Documentation
BA-DES-015 revision2; SA-DES-014 revision2 and SDK inventory 1.101.0; WORK-003; approved historical BA-ANA-016/SA-ANA-016.

## Planning and delivery
Groomed estimate: 8 points;72 contributor hours with first-three measurement/resplit checkpoint. Grooming must validate authoring and independent review capacity, exact model-dependency effort and one-sprint feasibility; split further by explicit operation-ID subsets if needed without changing the complete425 union. Requires approved design, DEV-STORY-061 audit/routing and DEV-STORY-069 frozen catalog/common patterns. Stories remain New until FEATURE-015 Waiting for Implementation. No authoring begins during design. Deliver content and review evidence to REST acceptance story and DEV-STORY-070 integration; final publication remains GitHub-only.

## Root cause
The local per-operation examples checked request and response shapes separately. No composed J12 path checked transaction-view File.get/content before commit, branch-view File.get/content after commit, or the difference between a terminal Build status and successful completion. The original reader therefore produced an incomplete sequence despite six method fixtures passing.

## Implemented correction
Commit `d2ce40a` adds a root-client SDK 1.101.0 journey with seven finite MockTransport cases: SUCCEEDED, FAILED, CANCELED, RUNNING after budget, lost upload reply, lost commit reply, and explicit abort. It asserts staged and committed file views, known transaction RID reconciliation, and exactly one create/upload/commit mutation where applicable. Transaction.md and Build.md explain the lifecycle and finite Build.jobs diagnostics. The public SDK jobs cursor probe and the seven-case journey exited 0 without public DNS/socket access. These are synthetic fixtures, not live tenant execution.

## Remaining verification
Independent tech-lead handoff reports source/API PASS for `d2ce40a`, pending durable peer comment. QA reports a final-candidate source-blind provisional 6/6 on snapshot `6949469` with 20 consulted files byte-matching, pending committed hashes and formal score. Preserve original 4/6 evidence. Do not resolve until these two records are durable. Contributor time remains untracked because actual hours were not measured.
